content.rationale: S3-explicit fixes that every crossing runs under a caller-supplied binary and root; S3-caller fixes that the seam's caller resolves the jj binary via PATH once and the repo root via `jj workspace root` at the current working directory, handing both across explicitly; M-layout places the module flat at src/context.rs. It searches PATH for jj and for git, runs the root query through the runner (M-jj) with root = cwd — no root is known yet — opens the store (M-store) on that same resolved root, and returns the substrate's handles — root, store, runner, and git binary — as one context (M-context-injection); the PATH search lives here, outside the boundary; when no workspace resolves, the context carries no root or store (S3-root-optional). The root and the store are reached through fallible accessors that refuse when the context is root-less (S3-root-required), naming the absence — the value M-refusal (popowxnw) renders — while the runner is always present and git is reached through its own fallible accessor.
